component.name: SevenPlus Calculator
component.summary: Calculator with standard, scientific, programmer and statistics modes

description.p: SevenPlus is a desktop calculator whose behaviour and layout follow a classic desktop calculator many people already know: immediate execution in Standard mode, operator precedence in Scientific mode, a 64-bit Programmer mode and a Statistics mode.

ul.li: History, memory, digit grouping, copy and paste
Unit conversion, date calculation and loan and fuel worksheets
Five built-in themes and user themes in TOML
Crisp at any display scale, fully usable with the keyboard

description.p: Exact arithmetic, five themes, accessibility and per-monitor DPI support.
